rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" bh_autotools_dev_update
# NOTE: quick hack, put this into a patch. sed -i 's@<sgidefs.h>@<asm/sgidefs.h>@g' "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/nspr/pr/include/md/_linux.cfg"
export CFLAGS="$CFLAGS -Wall -pipe" export LDFLAGS="$LDFLAGS -Wl,--as-needed"
if [ "`bh_os_bits $AELTRA_HOST_TYPE`" = "64" ]; then EXTRA_ARGS="--enable-64bit" else EXTRA_ARGS="" fi
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/nspr/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-debug \ --enable-debug-symbols \ --enable-optimize \ $EXTRA_ARGS
